auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Get a Kagi API key at https://kagi.com/settings/api and add API credits. Summarizer requests use Authorization: Bot <key>. The key is checked by Kagi on first execution; connecting only checks that it is nonempty.

actions.name: summarize
actions.description: Summarize text or a document URL with Kagi, optionally translating the summary or extracting key takeaways.

url.description: URL of a document, web page, audio file, or video for Kagi to fetch. Mutually exclusive with text.

text.description: Text to summarize. Mutually exclusive with url.

engine.description: Summarization engine; defaults to cecil. Daphne is a deprecated alias of agnes. Muriel uses enterprise pricing.

summary_type.description: Summary format; defaults to summary for prose, or takeaway for bullet points.

target_language.description: Output language code, normalized to uppercase. Supported: BG, CS, DA, DE, EL, EN, ES, ET, FI, FR, HU, ID, IT, JA, KO, LT, LV, NB, NL, PL, PT, RO, RU, SK, SL, SV, TR, UK, ZH, ZH-HANT.

cache.description: Allow Kagi to cache requests and responses; defaults to true. Set false for sensitive documents.

inputSchema.description: Document and summary options. The serialized request must not exceed 1 MB.

meta.description: Request metadata, including request ID, processing time, and API balance when available.

outputSchema.description: Kagi summary response with upstream metadata and extension fields.
